column1: # fa SYNTHESIZED referee — cross-source AGREEMENT gold (NON-CIRCULAR, convention-neutral).
# A word's pronunciation is kept ONLY where >=2 of 3 INDEPENDENT sources agree after normalizing to our
# IPA: wikipron-fas (Wiktionary) / GE2PE Kasre+Homograph (Sharif, Rahmati) / FarsDat (old speech corpus).
# Agreement filters each source's idiosyncratic convention noise (classical register, speech-corpus hamza,
# ق/غ merge) -> what survives is corroborated truth. CITATION forms (ezafe-tagged occurrences dropped).
